        continue
    
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(local_path), exist_ok=True)
    dl_url = f"{DOWNLOAD_BASE}/{name}"
    
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(dl_url, local_path)
        dt = time.time() - t0
        speed = size / 1024 / 1024 / max(dt, 0.001)
        downloaded += size
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(items)}] OK {rel_path} ({size/1024/1024:.1f} MB, {speed:.1f} MB/s) [{downloaded/1024/1024:.0f}/{total_size/1024/1024:.0f} MB]")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(items)}] FAIL {rel_path}: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

print("DOWNLOAD COMPLETE")

# Also download assets

ASSETS_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.cache/openpi/openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_base/assets"

items = data.get("items", [])
print(f"Assets: {len(items)} files")
for i, item in enumerate(items):
    name = item["name"]
    size = int(item.get("size", 0))
    rel_path = name.replace("checkpoints/pi0_base/assets/", "")
    local_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, rel_path)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(local_path), exist_ok=True)

print("ALL DONE")
